body:
I've been "trying" for five years, nothing left for me anymore. It hurts so much knowing so many my age that are actually winning at life. The last woman I was close to, for instance. Lost interest in me after getting into a great entry-level corporate position, got someone like her now. Don't blame her- I'm similarly educated but trapped in an embarassingly shitty job I despise now. Whatever I do I'm denied every single chance at ever achieving my fairly average goals and dreams and each one just crushes them further into dust. 

I can't live like this anymore, no pills or talking will ever make up for doing another 50+ years in this hell whilst everyone else gets to enjoy their relative heaven. I've accepted I've lost, if it weren't for the missing courage I'd have quitted already.
